# Assets hot-linked by the external GSE Profiler landing page.
#
# The landing page lives in the `todevelopers/flatpaks` repo and is served on
# GitHub Pages at https://todevelopers.github.io/flatpaks/gseprofiler/ . It loads
# the screenshots and the app icon DIRECTLY from this repo's `main` branch via
# raw.githubusercontent.com URLs. Renaming, moving, or deleting any file below
# silently breaks the published landing page.
#
# If you intentionally change one of these paths:
#   1. update the landing page in todevelopers/flatpaks (gseprofiler/index.html),
#   2. then update this list to match.
#
# One path per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
